MONETARY_POLICY.rate_decision_hike.label: Rate Decision — Hike
MONETARY_POLICY.rate_decision_hike.conflict_note: If QT already in progress, intensity_credit may be amplified

MONETARY_POLICY.rate_decision_cut.label: Rate Decision — Cut
MONETARY_POLICY.rate_decision_cut.conflict_note: If cutting into inflation, gold may diverge bullish

MONETARY_POLICY.rate_decision_hold.label: Rate Decision — Hold
MONETARY_POLICY.rate_decision_hold.conflict_note: Pure hold has minimal impact; dominant signal is the statement tone

MONETARY_POLICY.forward_guidance_hawkish.label: Forward Guidance — Hawkish
MONETARY_POLICY.forward_guidance_hawkish.conflict_note: Signal strength depends on market positioning; surprise factor amplifies

MONETARY_POLICY.forward_guidance_dovish.label: Forward Guidance — Dovish
MONETARY_POLICY.forward_guidance_dovish.conflict_note: If dovish pivot occurs amid high inflation, equities may rally but bonds less

MONETARY_POLICY.qe_announcement.label: QE Announcement
MONETARY_POLICY.qe_announcement.conflict_note: Diminishing returns on successive QE rounds; currency wars risk in multi-CB context

MONETARY_POLICY.qt_announcement.label: QT Announcement
MONETARY_POLICY.qt_announcement.conflict_note: Pace matters: $60bn vs $95bn/month has very different transmission speed

MONETARY_POLICY.tapering.label: Tapering
MONETARY_POLICY.tapering.conflict_note: Taper tantrum risk if unexpected; well-telegraphed tapers have limited impact

MONETARY_POLICY.emergency_action_easing.label: Emergency Action — Easing
MONETARY_POLICY.emergency_action_easing.conflict_note: Emergency actions signal CB sees a crisis; may paradoxically increase fear short-term

MONETARY_POLICY.emergency_action_tighten.label: Emergency Action — Tightening
MONETARY_POLICY.emergency_action_tighten.conflict_note: May signal currency stress; sovereign spread reaction depends on credibility

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.inflation_cpi_above.label: CPI — Above Expectations
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.inflation_cpi_above.conflict_note: If driven by energy alone, core inflation may diverge; central bank response varies

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.inflation_cpi_below.label: CPI — Below Expectations
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.inflation_cpi_below.conflict_note: Deflation risk context changes asset reaction: equities may sell if deflationary spiral feared

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.inflation_cpi_inline.label: CPI — In Line with Expectations
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.inflation_cpi_inline.conflict_note: Minimal price action; markets move on core vs headline divergence

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.gdp_above.label: GDP — Above Expectations
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.gdp_above.conflict_note: Strong GDP raises rate expectations; may be net negative for equities in inflation context

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.gdp_below.label: GDP — Below Expectations
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.gdp_below.conflict_note: Recession + high inflation = stagflation; bonds may also sell

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.gdp_revision_up.label: GDP Revision — Upward
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.gdp_revision_up.conflict_note: Revisions rarely move markets unless magnitude is large

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.gdp_revision_down.label: GDP Revision — Downward
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.gdp_revision_down.conflict_note: Downward revisions confirming recession fears more impactful

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.nfp_above.label: NFP — Above Expectations
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.nfp_above.conflict_note: Strong jobs in soft-landing scenario bullish equities; in inflation scenario bearish

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.nfp_below.label: NFP — Below Expectations
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.nfp_below.conflict_note: Weak jobs + high inflation = stagflation risk

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.unemployment_rise.label: Unemployment — Rising
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.unemployment_rise.conflict_note: Sahm Rule crossing 0.5% signals recession with high historical accuracy

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.unemployment_fall.label: Unemployment — Falling
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.unemployment_fall.conflict_note: Tight labor market signals wage pressure → inflation risk

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.pmi_expansion.label: PMI — Expansion
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.pmi_expansion.conflict_note: Leading indicator; actual GDP print may diverge

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.pmi_contraction.label: PMI — Contraction
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.pmi_contraction.conflict_note: Manufacturing vs Services divergence is key; services PMI more predictive in modern economy

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.trade_balance_deficit.label: Trade Balance — Deficit Widening
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.trade_balance_deficit.conflict_note: Trade deficit can be positive (strong domestic demand) or negative (structural weakness)

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.consumer_confidence_r.label: Consumer Confidence — Rising
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.consumer_confidence_r.conflict_note: Soft data; actual retail sales print is more actionable

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.consumer_confidence_f.label: Consumer Confidence — Falling
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.consumer_confidence_f.conflict_note: University of Michigan vs Conference Board have different leading properties

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.retail_sales_above.label: Retail Sales — Above Expectations
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.retail_sales_above.conflict_note: Control group retail sales (ex-auto, gas, food) most predictive for GDP

MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.retail_sales_below.label: Retail Sales — Below Expectations
MACRO_DATA_RELEASE.retail_sales_below.conflict_note: One-month miss often weather/seasonal; trend over 3m more meaningful

GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.armed_conflict_start.label: Armed Conflict — Start
GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.armed_conflict_start.conflict_note: UST safe haven bid competes with inflation/fiscal fear; depends on US involvement

GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.armed_conflict_escala.label: Armed Conflict — Escalation
GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.armed_conflict_escala.conflict_note: Escalation effects diminish with market fatigue; first event most impactful

GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.armed_conflict_ceasef.label: Armed Conflict — Ceasefire
GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.armed_conflict_ceasef.conflict_note: Credibility of ceasefire key; fragile truces have limited lasting market impact

GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.sanctions_announcemen.label: Sanctions — New Package Announced
GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.sanctions_announcemen.conflict_note: Secondary sanctions and implementation speed determine market impact magnitude

GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.sanctions_lifted.label: Sanctions — Lifted or Eased
GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.sanctions_lifted.conflict_note: Oil supply addition from sanctions lifting depends on target country capacity

GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.diplomatic_crisis.label: Diplomatic Crisis
GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.diplomatic_crisis.conflict_note: Diplomatic crises rarely move markets substantially unless escalation risk is high

GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.regime_change_unstabl.label: Regime Change — Destabilizing
GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.regime_change_unstabl.conflict_note: EM contagion depends on country size and financial linkages

GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.regime_change_stable.label: Regime Change — Stabilizing
GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.regime_change_stable.conflict_note: Market reaction depends on pre-existing risk premium compression

GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.major_terrorism.label: Major Terrorism Event
GEOPOLITICAL_SHOCK.major_terrorism.conflict_note: Recovery typically fast (days); 9/11 exception due to systemic disruption scale

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.opec_cut.label: OPEC+ Production Cut
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.opec_cut.conflict_note: Compliance rate and global demand outlook modulate magnitude of oil price move

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.opec_increase.label: OPEC+ Production Increase
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.opec_increase.conflict_note: Demand destruction context may limit price relief effect

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.oil_supply_disrup.label: Oil Supply Disruption
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.oil_supply_disrup.conflict_note: SPR releases can offset short-term; duration depends on reserve buffer vs outage

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.oil_demand_revisi.label: Oil Demand Revision — Upward
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.oil_demand_revisi.conflict_note: Agency revisions are lagging; market often already priced move

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.oil_demand_revisi.label: Oil Demand Revision — Downward
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.oil_demand_revisi.conflict_note: Long-term EV transition demand destruction = structural not cyclical

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.gas_supply_disrup.label: Natural Gas Supply Disruption
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.gas_supply_disrup.conflict_note: European economy particularly sensitive; industrial curtailment = GDP drag

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.gas_storage_alert.label: Gas Storage — Critical Alert
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.gas_storage_alert.conflict_note: EU 80% refill target is market anchor

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.agricultural_drou.label: Agricultural — Major Drought
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.agricultural_drou.conflict_note: Food inflation particularly impactful in EM where food weight in CPI is higher

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.agricultural_surp.label: Agricultural — Surplus / Bumper Harvest
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.agricultural_surp.conflict_note: Disinflation from food prices modest in DM where food weight is low

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.metals_shortage.label: Critical Metals — Shortage
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.metals_shortage.conflict_note: Critical minerals shortage increasingly geopolitical — China export controls risk

ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.metals_surplus.label: Critical Metals — Surplus
ENERGY_COMMODITY_SHOCK.metals_surplus.conflict_note: Chinese demand signal is primary driver of metals surplus/deficit cycle

TRADE_POLICY.tariff_hike.label: Tariff — New or Increased
TRADE_POLICY.tariff_hike.conflict_note: Retaliation risk amplifies impact; affected sectors (autos, agri, tech) diverge

TRADE_POLICY.tariff_cut.label: Tariff — Cut or Removal
TRADE_POLICY.tariff_cut.conflict_note: Impact depends on magnitude and strategic significance of goods targeted

TRADE_POLICY.tariff_threat.label: Tariff — Threat or Warning
TRADE_POLICY.tariff_threat.conflict_note: Markets increasingly desensitized to repeated threats

TRADE_POLICY.trade_agreement_signed.label: Trade Agreement — Signed
TRADE_POLICY.trade_agreement_signed.conflict_note: Markets often price in deal before signing; announcement effect may be limited

TRADE_POLICY.trade_agreement_collapsed.label: Trade Agreement — Collapsed
TRADE_POLICY.trade_agreement_collapsed.conflict_note: Uncertainty premium added; renegotiation risk vs clean break

TRADE_POLICY.export_restriction_tech.label: Export Restriction — Technology
TRADE_POLICY.export_restriction_tech.conflict_note: Long-term supply chain restructuring impact dominates short-term

TRADE_POLICY.export_restriction_commodit.label: Export Restriction — Commodity
TRADE_POLICY.export_restriction_commodit.conflict_note: Particularly inflationary for food-importing EM countries

TRADE_POLICY.currency_manipulation_accus.label: Currency Manipulation — Accusation
TRADE_POLICY.currency_manipulation_accus.conflict_note: Accusation rarely leads to formal action; political signaling dominates

TRADE_POLICY.trade_war_escalation.label: Trade War — Escalation
TRADE_POLICY.trade_war_escalation.conflict_note: Global supply chain disruption adds persistence to impact

TRADE_POLICY.trade_war_deescalation.label: Trade War — De-escalation
TRADE_POLICY.trade_war_deescalation.conflict_note: Partial deals may boost sentiment without fundamentally resolving tensions

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.fiscal_stimulus.label: Fiscal Stimulus — Major
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.fiscal_stimulus.conflict_note: Multiplier depends on output gap; stimulus in full employment = inflation not growth

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.fiscal_stimulus.label: Fiscal Stimulus — Minor
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.fiscal_stimulus.conflict_note: Narrow impact; sector-specific rather than macro

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.fiscal_austerit.label: Fiscal Austerity
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.fiscal_austerit.conflict_note: Expansionary austerity theory empirically weak; typically contractionary short-term

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.tax_hike_corpor.label: Corporate Tax Hike
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.tax_hike_corpor.conflict_note: Market impact front-runs effective date; actual vs proposed rate matters

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.tax_cut_corpora.label: Corporate Tax Cut
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.tax_cut_corpora.conflict_note: Buyback activity surge often first market signal of corporate tax cuts

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.tax_hike_consum.label: Consumer Tax Hike
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.tax_hike_consum.conflict_note: Japan VAT hikes historically triggered mini-recessions

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.financial_regul.label: Financial Regulation — Tightening
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.financial_regul.conflict_note: Long implementation timelines; financial stocks react to announcement

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.financial_regul.label: Financial Regulation — Easing
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.financial_regul.conflict_note: Moral hazard risk; short-term positive for banks, long-term systemic risk increase

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.sovereign_downg.label: Sovereign Credit Downgrade
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.sovereign_downg.conflict_note: US downgrade paradoxically can trigger UST rally (safe haven demand)

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.sovereign_upgra.label: Sovereign Credit Upgrade
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.sovereign_upgra.conflict_note: Often partially priced in; surprise upgrades have more impact

FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.debt_ceiling_cr.label: Debt Ceiling Crisis
FISCAL_REGULATORY_POLICY.debt_ceiling_cr.conflict_note: T-bills near X-date trade at big discount; resolution produces sharp V-shaped reversal

FINANCIAL_STABILITY.bank_failure.label: Bank Failure
FINANCIAL_STABILITY.bank_failure.conflict_note: Contagion speed amplified by social media bank run dynamics (SVB 2023)

FINANCIAL_STABILITY.bank_rescue.label: Bank Rescue / Bailout
FINANCIAL_STABILITY.bank_rescue.conflict_note: Rescue credibility depends on firepower; equity shareholders typically wiped out

FINANCIAL_STABILITY.credit_event_soverei.label: Credit Event — Sovereign Default
FINANCIAL_STABILITY.credit_event_soverei.conflict_note: Orderly restructuring vs disorderly default has very different contagion dynamics

FINANCIAL_STABILITY.credit_event_corpora.label: Credit Event — Corporate Default
FINANCIAL_STABILITY.credit_event_corpora.conflict_note: Sector contagion model matters: real estate vs crypto vs finance

FINANCIAL_STABILITY.market_crash.label: Market Crash
FINANCIAL_STABILITY.market_crash.conflict_note: Circuit breakers may pause market; Fed put probability high in severe crashes

FINANCIAL_STABILITY.flash_crash.label: Flash Crash
FINANCIAL_STABILITY.flash_crash.conflict_note: Flash crashes typically fully reverse; persistent fear signal if partial recovery only

FINANCIAL_STABILITY.contagion_spread_wid.label: Contagion — Spread Widening
FINANCIAL_STABILITY.contagion_spread_wid.conflict_note: Draghi 'whatever it takes' showed CB can arrest contagion

FINANCIAL_STABILITY.systemic_risk_warnin.label: Systemic Risk Warning
FINANCIAL_STABILITY.systemic_risk_warnin.conflict_note: Official warnings often lagging; BIS early warnings more prescient

FINANCIAL_STABILITY.liquidity_crisis.label: Liquidity Crisis
FINANCIAL_STABILITY.liquidity_crisis.conflict_note: Fed/ECB/BoE backstop credibility determines duration; swap lines resolve dollar shortage

SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.port_blockage.label: Port Blockage
SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.port_blockage.conflict_note: Suez blockage added ~$200bn/week in supply chain delays

SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.shipping_disrupt.label: Shipping Disruption
SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.shipping_disrupt.conflict_note: Drewry composite freight index is primary real-time indicator

SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.factory_shutdown.label: Major Factory Shutdown
SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.factory_shutdown.conflict_note: TSMC concentration risk = potential single-point failure for global semiconductor supply

SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.semiconductor_sh.label: Semiconductor Shortage
SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.semiconductor_sh.conflict_note: Lead times 12-18m in automotive; capex super-cycle creates future oversupply risk

SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.critical_materia.label: Critical Material Shortage
SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.critical_materia.conflict_note: Energy transition creates structural demand for Li, Co, Ni, rare earths through 2040+

SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.logistics_bottle.label: Logistics Bottleneck
SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.logistics_bottle.conflict_note: PMI supply delivery times is best aggregate proxy

SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.pandemic_supply_.label: Pandemic / Mass Disease Supply Shock
SUPPLY_CHAIN_DISRUPTION.pandemic_supply_.conflict_note: CB/fiscal response determines post-shock inflation trajectory

CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.drought_major.label: Major Drought
CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.drought_major.conflict_note: Rhine low water impacted German industrial output directly in 2022

CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.flood_major.label: Major Flood
CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.flood_major.conflict_note: Reconstruction spending partially offsets GDP drag

CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.hurricane_typho.label: Hurricane / Major Typhoon
CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.hurricane_typho.conflict_note: Katrina hit Gulf oil infrastructure; 2022 hurricanes impacted Florida insurance market

CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.earthquake_tsun.label: Major Earthquake / Tsunami
CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.earthquake_tsun.conflict_note: Japan repatriated yen post-Fukushima → JPY strength despite disaster

CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.wildfire_major.label: Major Wildfire
CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.wildfire_major.conflict_note: PG&E bankruptcy from California wildfires shows utility sector tail risk

CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.climate_policy_.label: Major Climate Policy Announced
CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.climate_policy_.conflict_note: IRA $369bn triggered massive capex reallocation to US green manufacturing

CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.carbon_tax_anno.label: Carbon Tax / ETS Announced
CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.carbon_tax_anno.conflict_note: Carbon border adjustment (CBAM) creates new trade policy dimension

CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.green_deal_regu.label: Green Deal / ESG Regulation
CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.green_deal_regu.conflict_note: Compliance costs vs capital reallocation; long lag to economic impact

CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.energy_transiti.label: Energy Transition Target Announced
CLIMATE_NATURAL_DISASTER.energy_transiti.conflict_note: Target credibility depends on policy mechanism; EU has binding targets

TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.ai_breakthrough_ma.label: Major AI Breakthrough
TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.ai_breakthrough_ma.conflict_note: Productivity shock potential: general purpose technology multiplier ~5-10x direct effect

TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.tech_antitrust_act.label: Tech Antitrust Action
TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.tech_antitrust_act.conflict_note: EU DMA/DSA more impactful than US antitrust due to faster enforcement

TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.tech_export_ban.label: Technology Export Ban
TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.tech_export_ban.conflict_note: NVIDIA H100/H800 controls most impactful for AI supply chain globally

TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.productivity_shock.label: Positive Productivity Shock
TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.productivity_shock.conflict_note: Productivity shocks have long lags; market prices future earnings

TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.cyber_attack_criti.label: Cyber Attack — Critical Infrastructure
TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.cyber_attack_criti.conflict_note: Colonial Pipeline: +30% east coast fuel prices in days

TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.cyber_attack_finan.label: Cyber Attack — Financial System
TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.cyber_attack_finan.conflict_note: Payment system disruption most systemic; SWIFT alternatives reduce concentration risk

TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.demographic_struct.label: Demographic Structural Shift
TECHNOLOGY_STRUCTURAL.demographic_struct.conflict_note: Ultra-long horizon (decades); markets price via yield curve shape
